simple.summary: גַּלִּים (Gallîym) means Gallim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Sam 25 44.

definitions.full: H1554. Gallim גַּלִּים proper name, of a location ( heaps ); — place north of Jerusalem 1Sam 25:44 ; personified as ׳בַּתגִֿ Isa 10:30 .
